Players Committee card image of [[Starkiller Base: Interrogation Room (Prison)]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' If Kylo here and And Now You'll Give It To Me on table, opponent's Force drains are +2 here. '''Dark Side:''' During your move phase, may use 2 Force to move Kylo between here and a battleground.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/starkillerbaseinterrogationroomprison.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
